summary: Postinstall script in package using a Solana-related name requires manual review
details: Package @solana-labs/ancor@1.0.5 declares a postinstall lifecycle hook ("postinstall": "node install.js" in package.json) that runs install.js automatically on npm install. The package name closely resembles the legitimate @coral-xyz/anchor / Anchor framework in the Solana ecosystem and uses a @solana-labs scope that may impersonate official Solana Labs packages. The contents of install.js were not traced in this analysis, so the actual on-install behavior is unverified. Given the name-impersonation shape combined with an auto-executing postinstall script, manual review of install.js is warranted before installation is permitted.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
